name: ado-link-bar
description: Links in the band above the prompt to the Azure DevOps pull requests and work items mentioned most recently in the conversation.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show Azure DevOps links in the band above the prompt.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Azure DevOps organization used to link AB#1234 mentions (dev.azure.com/<organization>). Empty: AB# mentions are ignored.

pullRequests.title: Pull requests
pullRequests.description: How many of the most recently mentioned pull requests to link. 0 shows none.

workItems.title: Work items
workItems.description: How many of the most recently mentioned work items to link. 0 shows none.
